extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, patent attorneys/agents, and patent examiners (U.S. practice)
extracted.subtask_description: Consolidated U.S. patent rules and Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP) guidance covering procedural and substantive requirements for filing, prosecution, post‑grant proceedings, fees, and related matters. Used by practitioners and examiners for compliance and practice before the USPTO and PTAB.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension of patent term (examination delay and regulatory review)
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension of patent term due to examination delay under the URAA (35 U.S.C. 154) and due to regulatory review period (35 U.S.C. 156).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes rules on applicant/application for extension, calculation of term (by product type: human drug product, animal drug product, food or color additive, medical device, veterinary biological product), certificate of extension, conditions for extension, correction of informalities, determination of eligibility, duty of disclosure, filing date and formal requirements, incomplete application, interim extensions under 35 U.S.C. 156(d)(5) and 156(e)(2), multiple applications, orders granting/terminating interim extensions, and patents subject to extension (see sections 1.701–1.791).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees and payment of money
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing fees, methods of payment, and payment-related procedures applicable to patent practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers application size fees, credit card payments, deposit accounts, document supply fees, extension of time fees, fee on appeal to CAFC, fees payable in advance, itemization, method of payment, money sent by mail (risk to sender), money paid by mistake, fees necessary for application to be complete, petition fees, prioritized examination fees, processing fees, reexamination request fees, refunds, fees relating to international applications, schedule of fees and charges (1.16–1.21, and various specific subsections such as 1.17, 1.19, 1.20, 1.21, 1.22, 1.23, 1.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing date and completeness of application
rubrics_metrics.description: What is necessary for an application to receive a filing date and how incomplete applications are handled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes filing date of application rules, missing pages when filed, formal requirements, and when an application is considered incomplete (see 1.51, 1.53, 1.741, 1.741(e)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority claims and provisional applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedures for claiming domestic and foreign priority, and rules for provisional applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers cross-reference to related applications, claiming benefit, petitions to accept unintentionally delayed domestic or foreign benefit claims, indication requirements on application data sheet, translation requirements for non‑English provisionals, filing fee requirements for provisionals, cover sheet and application data sheet requirements, filing date rules for provisionals, and that provisionals receive no examination (see 1.53, 1.55, 1.76–1.78).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information Disclosure Statement (IDS) and duty of disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Content and timing rules for Information Disclosure Statements and the duty to disclose relevant prior art.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies IDS content, prohibition of IDS in provisional applications, IDS use in reexamination, suspension of action to allow IDS consideration in a CPA, third-party submission mechanisms, and IDS as a means to comply with duty of disclosure (see 1.51, 1.56, 1.97, 1.98, 1.103, 1.290–1.291, 1.555, 1.902).

rubrics_metrics.name: Oath or declaration requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for inventor oaths and declarations in patent applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes who may make the oath/declaration, use of assignments as oath/declaration, officers authorized to administer oaths, foreign and international situations, substitute statements, signature requirements, inclusion as part of a complete application, and procedural cross‑references for continuation‑in‑part, reissue, plant applications (see 1.63–1.69, 1.66, 1.41, 1.64, 1.68, 1.162, 1.175).

rubrics_metrics.name: New matter inadmissibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Prohibition on adding new matter to a patent application or reissue application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New matter is inadmissible in application amendments and reissue applications (see 1.121(f), 1.173(a)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Nucleotide and amino acid sequence disclosure requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for format, content, submission, and fees for nucleotide/amino acid sequence listings in patent applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers amendments to sequence listings, disclosure in patent applications, mega‑sequence listing fee for very long sequence listings, form and format requirements, symbols and format for sequence data, replacement, requirements, and submission on optical disc (see 1.821–1.835, 1.52, 1.824, 1.822/1.832, 1.21(o)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Interference proceedings (derivation/pre-AIA interferences)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for interference proceedings between parties claiming the same invention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes declaration of interference, addition of patents/applications, motions, discovery, burden of proof, presumption as to order of invention, priority statements, concession of priority, notice requirements, jurisdiction over files, sanctions, service of papers, translations, time periods for completion, records availability, and related petitions (see Part 41, esp. 41.103–41.208, 41.121, 41.150–41.156, 41.200–41.208).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inter partes review (IPR) practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedures for instituting and conducting inter partes review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers content of the petition, fee, filing date, institution of review, amendments to the patent, filing of supplemental information, multiple proceedings and joinder, and related procedural rules (see Part 42, 42.100–42.123, 42.121–42.123, 42.108–42.122).

rubrics_metrics.name: Post‑grant review practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for post‑grant review proceedings challenging patents post-issuance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes content of the petition, fee, filing date, filing of supplemental information, institution thresholds, amendment of the patent, discovery limits, multiple proceedings/joinder, pendency, preliminary response, response by patent owner, service, and timing (see 42.200–42.224, 42.201–42.223).

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB) practice and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: General conduct, management, and procedural rules for PTAB trials and appeals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes conduct of the proceeding, duty of candor, mandatory notices, fees, filing of documents and exhibits, notice of trial, oral argument, judgment, management of the record, policy, public availability, sanctions, service of documents, settlement, testimony and production rules (admissibility, applicability of Federal Rules of Evidence, discovery, expert testimony, protective orders), page and word count limits for petitions/motions/briefs, and termination of trial (see Part 42, esp. 42.1–42.80, 42.4–42.8, 42.51–42.74).

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions and motions practice before the PTAB and Director
rubrics_metrics.description: Content, timing, and decision standards for petitions and motions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses content of petitions and motions, default filing times, notice of basis for relief, oppositions and replies, decision on petitions/motions, page/word limits, policy, public availability, and petition fees and timing; includes petitions to the Director on matters not specifically provided for and petitions for relief or special status (see 42.20–42.25, 1.181–1.183, 1.78(d)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Preissuance third‑party submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Mechanisms and content rules for third parties to submit prior art for consideration before patent issuance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preissuance submissions by third parties and related rules (see 1.115, 1.290–1.291).

rubrics_metrics.name: Models, exhibits, and working models
rubrics_metrics.description: When models or exhibits may be required or accepted and procedures for custody and return.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules on requirement of models or working models if necessary on examination, use of models in contested cases, custody by sworn employee, return procedures, disposal without notice unless return arrangements are made (see 1.91–1.95, 41.154).

rubrics_metrics.name: Plant patent applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Special rules and content requirements applicable to plant patent applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers applicant and claim requirements, declaration, description, drawings, examination, fee structure, oath, specimens, rules applicable to plant patents, and specification arrangement (see 1.161–1.167, 1.162–1.166).

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintenance fees, acceptance of delayed payment, and revival
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for paying maintenance fees, acceptance of delayed payments, and reviving abandoned applications or patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers maintenance fee payment procedures, acceptance of delayed payments, address for payments and correspondence, time for payment, revival of abandoned applications, and fees for revival (see 1.20, 1.23, 1.137, 1.362–1.378).

rubrics_metrics.name: Micro entity and small entity status
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions and fee consequences for entity status classifications (micro, small, nonprofit).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines nonprofit organization, small entity and micro entity status, entitlement to reduced fees, and related requirements (see 1.27–1.29).

rubrics_metrics.name: International (PCT) and national stage practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures, fees, and content requirements for international applications (PCT) and entry into the U.S. national stage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes content requirements for international design applications, international preliminary examination, international filing fee and other fees, designation/entry into national stage, entry procedures, examination at national stage, Oath/declaration at national stage, priority claim practices, record copy transmittal, representation by attorney/agent, and time limits for processing (see 1.401–1.497, 1.412–1.497, 1.431–1.496).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notices and communications (office actions, notices of allowance/rejection)
rubrics_metrics.description: When and how the Office gives notices such as office actions, notices of allowance, and notices of rejection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers notices of allowance, notice of rejection, notice of oral hearings before PTAB, notice of taking testimony, notices of declaration of interference, and requirements for official actions to be based exclusively on the written record (see 1.2, 1.104, 1.311, 41.47, 41.73, 41.157).

rubrics_metrics.name: Document form, legibility, and physical requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal requirements for papers to be part of the Office permanent records, legibility standards, photographs, drawings, formulas and tables, paper definition, and physical requirements for international filings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes rules on legibility of papers, physical requirements for international filings and drawings, photographs, mask work notices, formulas and tables, page/word count limitations for PTAB filings, and paper definition (see 1.9, 1.52, 1.56–1.58, 1.84, 1.433–1.438, 42.24).
